registry_metadata.title: Production City Dashboard — Complete Feature Registry
registry_metadata.purpose: Exhaustive catalogue of all dashboard functionality required across the full Production City lifecycle — from company formation through to global multi-campus operations. Every entry becomes either an active page or a 'Coming Soon' placeholder in the dashboard scaffold.

schema.label: Human-readable display name
schema.phase: Phase of company lifecycle when this feature becomes relevant
schema.priority: p0 (scaffold) | p1 (first wave) | p2 (second wave) | p3 (future)
schema.roles: User roles that can access this feature
schema.bible_ref: Reference to project bible section that drives this requirement
schema.keywords: Optional array of search synonyms for the CommandBar (e.g., ['people', 'staff', 'employees'] for Team Directory)

phases.company_formation: Day 1 — internal team operations, fundraising, board
phases.site_acquisition: Identifying and securing land for each campus
phases.planning_approvals: DA, zoning, heritage, environmental, community consultation
phases.operations: Campus is live — productions, events, education, hospitality
phases.expansion: Subsequent campuses — repeat site→operations cycle globally

role_definitions.client: Production companies and content creators booking facilities/services
role_definitions.guest: Public visitors — event attendees, tour participants, students
role_definitions.partner: Technology partners, educational institutions, industry collaborators
role_definitions.first_nations: First Nations advisory board members and community representatives

registry_metadata.bible_ref_note: Features with null bible_ref are derived from operational requirements, industry-standard practices, or domain knowledge beyond the scope of the original briefing document. The briefing document covers vision, facilities, and stakeholder value but does not prescribe internal operational systems like HR, payroll, inventory, or IT administration.
